_meta.purpose: Hero Adventures data for Mission Roulette. Author-provided facts are authoritative; 'TODO' fields need author input.

conventions.buyIn: aUEC you pay to START the mission. Only Rock Cracker has one (~800k). null = no buy-in. (aUEC figures on other heroes are REWARDS, not buy-ins.)
conventions.ammoWarning: true = bring extra ammo, no mid-mission restock. Armour/gear is otherwise the player's choice and not tracked.
conventions.location 'random': mission-marker driven — the game places it, so no fixed site.
conventions.Wikelo material: hero reward items (tongue/eyes, gems, pearls/teeth) are INPUTS Wikelo needs — NOT directly redeemable; Wikelo usually needs several and/or other items too to unlock something.
conventions.inferred fields: category, tools, aspirationsServed, storyRole, difficulty, deathRisk are guesses — verify. Steps, rep, players, buy-in/reward, duration, giver, location came from the author.

hero-yormandi.name: Yormandi
steps: Fly to an ASD facility
Enter the Science Wing and head to Site B
In Site B, descend into the caves off the main path
Defeat Yormandi
hero-yormandi.shipsRequired: any ship (transport to the site); activity is on-foot
hero-yormandi.authorNotes: Bring lots of ammo — no restock in the caves.

hero-hyperion.name: Hyperion
hero-hyperion.location: random — driven by the mission marker
hero-hyperion.prerequisites: Complete ALL ASD investigation missions to unlock
hero-hyperion.authorNotes: PAYS 771k aUEC (not a buy-in). Gated by completing all ASD investigation missions. = 'ASD - Project Hyperion' (asd3) in SCHub crafting/mission_names.json.

hero-hathor-align-and-mine.name: Hathor — Align and Mine
hero-hathor-align-and-mine.location: Aberdeen (Ruptura, Vivere) and Daymar (Lamina, Attritus). Structure: PAFs → OLP → ground station beneath OLP
steps: At each of the 3 PAFs, collect 3 cards (9 total) to unlock that PAF's antenna
Collect a large battery at each PAF (3 total)
Transport the 3 batteries to the OLP and place them
Activating the OLP gives you a card
Use the OLP card at the ground station (beneath the OLP) to turn on the laser
Mine the exposed gems: Carnite, Jaclium, Saldynium (Wikelo material)
hero-hathor-align-and-mine.duration: ~2–3h total (align + activate ~1–2h; mining ≤1h — the cave closes; PvP-dependent)
hero-hathor-align-and-mine.shipsRequired: a ship that can carry 3 large batteries; + travel
hero-hathor-align-and-mine.gear: Hand mining tool + geo gadget for the gem phase; armour is player's choice
hero-hathor-align-and-mine.deathRisk: high (open-world PvP while mining the gems)
hero-hathor-align-and-mine.authorNotes: Mining window is short — the cave closes (≤1h). Gem phase is the hardest part due to potential PvP. Sites: Aberdeen (Ruptura, Vivere), Daymar (Lamina, Attritus).

hero-siege-of-orison.name: Siege of Orison
hero-siege-of-orison.location: Crusader / Orison — driven by the mission marker
hero-siege-of-orison.schedule: In PTU now; releases to live ~mid-Aug 2026. A repeatable MISSION remake of the old Siege of Orison (SOO) events — not a timed event.
hero-siege-of-orison.shipsRequired: any ship (transport to Crusader/Orison); activity is on-foot
hero-siege-of-orison.rewards: aUEC + blueprint + a super-heavy armour set (from the old SOO)
hero-siege-of-orison.authorNotes: Remake of old SOO events. Bring lots of ammo — no mid-mission restock. Flip status to active on live release.

hero-valakkar-stormbreaker.name: Valakkar — Stormbreaker
hero-valakkar-stormbreaker.location: Pyro IV: Farro datacenters (egg card) → Pyro I: Lazarus Sites — Phoenix (3 locations) / Tithonus (3 locations)
steps: Head to Pyro IV and collect the egg card (Farro datacenters)
Travel to a Pyro I Lazarus Site (Phoenix or Tithonus — 3 locations each)
Use the shuttle to travel to the complex
Unlock the egg and transport it to the tower
Fight the Valakkar boss
hero-valakkar-stormbreaker.duration: ~2–3h (≈1h for the egg card + 1–2h for the unlock and boss)
hero-valakkar-stormbreaker.shipsRequired: any ship (interplanetary transport Pyro IV → Pyro I)
hero-valakkar-stormbreaker.authorNotes: Minimum 2 players — not soloable. Bring lots of ammo — no mid-fight restock.

hero-contested.name: Contested
hero-contested.location: Ruin Station, Orbituary, Checkmate, PYAM-Security (red cards) → redeem at PYAM-Exchange
steps: Get red card(s) from PYAM-Security — they open the red doors
Ruin Station: collect 2 cards
Orbituary: collect 2 cards — BOTH are behind a red door (needs a red card)
Checkmate: collect 3 cards — 2 are open access, 1 is behind a red door (needs a red card)
Take all 7 cards to PYAM-Exchange and redeem for a ship
hero-contested.storyRole: TODO (ship reward could make this a major milestone)
hero-contested.authorNotes: The 'cards → ship at PYAM-Exchange' loop, fully author-maintained. 7 cards: 2 at Ruin, 2 at Orbituary (red-door gated), 3 at Checkmate (1 red-door gated).

hero-rockcracker.name: Rockcracker

hero-rockcracker.authorNotes: The ONLY buy-in hero (~800k to start). Most soloable hero (1 = doable) — strong solo-mode candidate.
